functions.name: releases
functions.description: Canonical GitHub releases selected through repository populations, exact release ID, exact tag, or GitHub latest-release lookup. The release author is the publisher role; publication time and draft/prerelease state remain explicit. Existing REST responses retain typed publisher and reaction snapshots, optional rendered notes and reported mention/reaction counters. Absent optional fields stay NULL. Embedded assets are deliberately excluded; release_assets traverses the complete asset endpoint.

metrics.name: release_count
metrics.comment: Selected release records, including visible drafts and prereleases; one observation per stable repository/release identity.

metrics.name: published_release_count
metrics.comment: Selected release records with a publication instant, including prereleases.

metrics.name: release_publication_day_count
metrics.comment: Distinct UTC dates with publication among selected releases; NULL draft publication dates are excluded and counts are non-additive across repositories.

derived_fields.name: release_published_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC release publication date, NULL for unpublished drafts.

draft_release_count.comment: Visible releases marked draft. Draft visibility depends on caller permissions.

prerelease_count.comment: Selected releases marked prerelease, independently of draft status.

release_reported_mention_count.comment: Sum of current mention counters reported for selected releases. Missing observations remain NULL; not mentions during a publication date range.

release_reported_reaction_count.comment: Sum of current reaction counters reported for selected releases. Missing observations remain NULL; not reaction creation events during a publication date range.

functions.name: release_assets
functions.description: Canonical GitHub release assets, distinct from Actions artifacts. Lists traverse every asset page for each selected release. Direct asset lookup preserves the same asset identity and metadata but leaves release_id unknown because that API response omits its parent. Publisher and uploader are separate actor roles. Parent release identity remains available in detail and release-to-assets retrieval remains declared. Analytical enrichment through the parent release, including its publisher, is not approved; assets retain their direct repository and uploader relationships, including known repository context when release_id is unknown. The nullable uploader snapshot is retained as a typed account record without an additional account lookup.

metrics.name: release_asset_count
metrics.comment: Current release asset metadata records at repository/asset identity; not Actions artifacts and not historical uploads.

metrics.name: uploaded_release_asset_count
metrics.comment: Current assets whose upload state is uploaded; open assets are retained in release_asset_count.

metrics.name: median_release_asset_size_bytes
metrics.comment: Exact median current byte size across selected assets, including zero-byte open uploads.

derived_fields.name: release_asset_created_day
derived_fields.comment: UTC asset creation date; independent of parent release publication.

release_asset_size_bytes.comment: Sum of current byte sizes over distinct selected assets; not cumulative transfer volume.

release_asset_download_count.comment: Sum of lifetime download counters observed now for distinct selected assets; not downloads during the query date range.
